BUILT.title: RiskMandate: Agent Behaviour Policies
BUILT.oneLine: A record of what each AI agent can reach, what it is allowed to do, and the gap between the two.
BUILT.quote: a record of what each AI agent can reach, what it's allowed to do, and the gap between the two.
BUILT.paragraph: RiskMandate writes an Agent Behaviour Policy for every AI agent a company runs: what the agent can reach, what the company authorised it to do, the gap between the two, and what stands in the way. Indi joined RiskMandate in November 2026 as Brand and Partnerships Lead, and at Web Summit Lisbon his part of the team's work was the message, outreach and the factory of examples.

BUILT.oneLine: A newsroom mapping AI in Portugal, run by people and AI agents together.

BUILT.paragraph: PrompTugal.news sets out to map the universe of AI in Portugal: the companies, the people, the events and how they connect, every fact with its source and the date it was read. Its articles are written by AI agents and edited by people. Indi is one of its three editors, with Dinis Cruz and another team member.

BUILT.title: Lisbon Tech Fringe
BUILT.oneLine: When Storm Charles cancelled Wednesday, the team built a guide to the side events, and an app, the same day.
BUILT.quote: when Storm Charles cancelled Wednesday, we built a guide to the side events, and an app, the same day.
BUILT.paragraph: On 10 November at 19:09, as Storm Charles reached Lisbon, Web Summit called off its second day. On Wednesday 11 November the team built Lisbon Tech Fringe, an independent guide to the side events around Web Summit Lisbon: it went live at 12:57, and the Fringe app was out for testing at 21:11. Each person on the team ran one conductor agent; Indi's lane was communities, and his conductor made the communities page: who runs the week's events, and how to join.

summary.text: A student from West London who, before starting university, is working with Dinis Cruz at RiskMandate. At Web Summit Lisbon 2026 he worked with a team of 27 AI agents, and he is looking for work experience.

paragraphs: He describes himself as a student passionate about languages, who will read Modern Languages and International Relations at university from next autumn.

He speaks English, Italian and French, has an interest in Sanskrit, and the same interest in programming languages. He builds software as a junior developer for three health technology startups, and is working through Harvard's CS50x.
He recently joined RiskMandate, which lets companies set a clear, auditable mandate for what their AI can access, decide and act on.
Volunteering in hospitals in London and rural Italy left him with a lasting interest in medicine, and drew him towards diplomacy, "where languages, judgement and tact meet".
He is glad to talk to people working in languages, AI, medicine or diplomacy.

The pages speak about you as "he", with first person in the menu and buttons. Would you prefer the whole site in the first person?
Which design should be the home page? The Briefing is proposed; Lingua is the alternative.
Your photo shows part of another person at the bottom left; the site crops it out. Is the crop fine, or would you send another photo?
When are you available for work experience, for how long, and where (London, remote, abroad)?

What does SportsHealing Ltd do, and what do you do there as Operations Manager?

What was your own part in Lisbon Tech Fringe beyond the communities page?

The Briefing is labelled with 18 November 2026, the date the facts were read. Is that fine?

lines: Hi all, I'm Indi Gupte from West London. Before starting university, I'm working with Dinis Cruz at RiskMandate, and it was a real privilege to be at Web Summit this year. What we built this week:
- RiskMandate: Agent Behaviour Policies, a record of what each AI agent can reach, what it's allowed to do, and the gap between the two. riskmandate.ai
- PrompTugal.news: a newsroom mapping AI in Portugal, run by people and AI agents together. promptugal.news
- Lisbon Tech Fringe: when Storm Charles cancelled Wednesday, we built a guide to the side events, and an app, the same day. lisbontechfringe.com
I'm also working with OmKneeHealth, a London health startup making knee treatment simpler. kneelens.com
What I bring: company research, design (I designed our business cards), and working every day with a team of AI agents.
I'm looking for work experience. If you have an opening, or know someone who might...

VIDEO.title: How Indi built the Lisbon Tech Fringe app with a team of AI agents
VIDEO.summary: At the end of Web Summit, Indi built an iOS app for Lisbon Tech Fringe in two to three hours with a team of AI agents: design agents, coding agents, and synthetic users playing attendee personas. He had no earlier iOS experience. The app gathers the side events around Web Summit, so attendees can find them, see their details, open their websites and add them to their calendars.
VIDEO.attribution: Dinis Cruz, in his post with the video
